connector.name: Company Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Exec comp benchmarking, say-on-pay risk, and governance cards for US public companies.
connector.summary: Hosted at velarion-scraper-production.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.velarion, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Velarion-Agent-Token
headers.description: Velarion agent token. Request one at https://intel.velarion.ai — tokens are per-agent, scoped, and revocable.
